original: Mols Bjerge National Park or WPRPLACE is a Danish national park in the area known as Mols Bjerge in Syddjurs Municipality, Central Jutland, inaugurated on 29 August [dated source]. The protected area, measures 180 square kilometres in size. The Mols Hills, reaching a height of 137 metres, are centrally located in the park, and take up 2,500 ha. "More than half of all wild Danish plant species" can be found at Mols Bjerge.
